subject: Next steps & pilot onboarding: NimbleOps discovery -> POC readiness
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@nimbleops.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbleops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: NimbleOps problem areas & proposed pilot scope

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap so we have alignment and a concrete set of next steps to get a short pilot running.

Key pain / goals you shared:
- Latency and cost spikes with current on-prem model when concurrency rises (>50 concurrent sessions).
- Need predictable 95th percentile latency for user-facing flows (support agents).
- Model output quality matters for intent classification and short-answer summarization (reduce manual review).
- Data residency: logs retained for 30 days, redaction on PII required.

Proposed pilot objective:
- Validate that Redwood Inference can serve your intent-classification + summarization pipeline with P95 latency <200ms, maintain F1 >= 0.85 on your labeled set, and reduce per-token unit cost by at least 25% vs current baseline.

Scope (initial):
- Two endpoints: 1) intent classifier (batch scoring) 2) live summarizer (streaming for agents).
- Seed prompt/eval set: ~100 representative prompts (we'll iterate).
- Data: use a 10k-message anonymized sample + live traffic shadowing for performance validation.

Owners (redwood / nimbleops):
- Redwood AM: Grace O'Connor (me) — engagement lead, timeline/coordination.
- Redwood Eng Lead: Ben Carter — infra/provisioning and monitoring.
- Redwood Solutions: Priyom Das — prompt tuning / eval harness.
- NimbleOps Eng: Liam Turner — infra/s3 access and test traffic.
- NimbleOps Product: Priya Shah — success metrics and acceptance.

Immediate asks to unblock pilot:
1) Share a sanitized 10k sample (S3 link or secure Drive) + schema: fields, label format.
2) Whitelist Redwood egress IP range (I can provide) or set up a peered VPC for the private deployment (your preference).
3) Create a service account for Redwood with read access to the bucket and link to a low-priv API key for testing.
4) Confirm data retention & redaction constraints (you mentioned 30 days — confirm).

Tentative timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): access granted, small SOW issued for signatures.
- Week 1: environment + seed prompt imports + baseline runs.
- Week 2: prompt tuning, latency optimizations, telemetry dashboarding.
- Week 3: acceptance window and success metric review.

Attachments I'm sending: pilot-access-checklist.csv (access asks), prompt-set-seed.xlsx (example prompts), draft SOW stub (NimbleOps_SOW_draft_v1.pdf).

Can you confirm the access plan and whether procurement needs a different SOW template? If that's OK, I'll circulate an updated SOW and a DocuSign link and kick off provisioning with Ben.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Grace
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

---
From: Liam Turner <liam.turner@nimbleops.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbleops.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: NimbleOps problem areas & proposed pilot scope

Appreciate the concise recap, Grace — that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Data/sample: we'll provide a gzipped anonymized S3 export (10k rows) by EOD Tuesday. Format will be {conversation_id, user_message, agent_message, label_intent, created_at}.
- Retention: confirmed 30 days; redaction rules: remove PII fields and mask account numbers. We can provide a script to sanitize if helpful.
- Networking: we'd prefer to try a peered VPC for the pilot (short-term) — can your infra team share the peering request template?
- Security: our InfoSec needs a short tech note on how logs are handled and where keys are stored (KMS/HSM). Can Ben or someone share that?
- SOW: procurement asked if you can add a short clause about data deletion at pilot end and a Net 30 standard payment term. They also requested to be CC'd on the SOW circulation (procurement@nimbleops.com).

On acceptance criteria: we agree to the P95 and F1 targets as starting points. For summarization we'll share 20 high-priority transcripts we care most about.

I'll loop in procurement once we have the SOW draft and the peering template. We'll aim to have access ready by end of week.

Thanks,
Liam
Engineering Manager, NimbleOps
liam.turner@nimbleops.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@nimbleops.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbleops.com>, procurement@nimbleops.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Pilot kickoff: scope, owners, timelines, and SOW (v1)

Thanks Liam — great to see the sample plan coming together. Per your asks, attached is SOW v1 (NimbleOps_SOW_draft_v1.pdf) with a short data-deletion clause and Net 30 placeholder. I also attached the access checklist and a seed prompt set for your review.

Pilot kickoff summary (finalized):
- Scope: intent classification (batch) + summarization (streaming).
- Seed evals: 100 prompts for classification, 40 transcripts for summarization (20 priority + 20 diversity set).
- Success metrics: P95 latency < 200ms (streaming); classification F1 >= 0.85 on the seeded test set; operational cost target -25% unit cost vs baseline.
- Owners: Grace (AM), Ben (Eng Lead), Priyom (Solutions), Liam (NimbleOps Eng), Priya (Product).
- Infra model: Redwood Private (peered VPC) for the pilot; we'll use ephemeral keys and KMS integration as required.

Access / onboarding checklist (high level):
1) Provide sanitized S3 sample: s3://nimbleops-pilot/samples/10k-sanitized.gz
2) Create the "redwood-pilot" service account with read-only access to that path.
3) Whitelist Redwood BGP ranges or approve VPC peering request (I attached the peering template).
4) Furnish a list of endpoints and any proxy rules for live traffic shadowing.
5) Confirm the retention window (30 days) and signed SOW to proceed with provisioning.

Prompt & eval plan:
- Priyom will import the seed prompts and produce the first evaluation run within 48 hours of access. We'll iterate prompts and quantization profiles to meet latency/cost targets.

Timeline: (dates tentative once access confirmed)
- Day 0: SOW signed + access granted.
- Day 1-3: environment standing, baseline runs on sample.
- Day 4-10: prompt tuning + telemetry; first acceptance checkpoint at Day 10.
- Day 11-21: iterative optimizations and final acceptance.

Next steps for you by EOD Friday:
- Confirm procurement point of contact and routing for SOW (procurement@nimbleops.com is fine).
- Share the sanitized S3 link and create the service account.
- Confirm whether you want a short tech brief for InfoSec or if Ben can share the KMS diagram (Ben will do that once you OK peering).

I'll generate a DocuSign SOW link and share the peering template separately. Once SOW is signed I will kick Ben to begin provisioning and Priyom to import prompts.

Best,
Grace
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

---

If you can send an updated SOW with the highlighted clause and the invoice/billing contact info, we'll get PO routing started.
